title: Nostalgic Japanese Chicken Tsukune
description: A traditional Japanese dish featuring chicken tsukune with a yeasty flavor, served in a hot dolsot stone bowl, incorporating pecorino cheese for a unique twist, and made with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ground chicken, pecorino cheese, yeast, ginger, green onions, sesame oil, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small tsukune balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the tsukune balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each ball.
Bake the tsukune in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the tsukune is baking, heat a dolsot stone bowl over medium heat.
Once the tsukune is done, remove it from the oven and carefully place it into the heated dolsot stone bowl.
Serve the tsukune hot, straight from the stone bowl.
